title: Which Hand Was Late? Diagnosis for Robot Failure Recovery in Bimanual Tool Use
abstract: arXiv:2610.37533v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Failure diagnosers for robot manipulation are increasingly vision--language models (VLMs), trained and evaluated on single-arm failures produced by perturbing a successful demonstration. Bimanual tool use adds failures of other kinds: a tool that slips out of its socket while still held, two correct gestures made at different times, and attempts that fail for two reasons at once. On a simulated bimanual tool-use task whose failure causes are read from the recorded trace, we measure what each sensing channel lets a diagnoser tell. The tool's slip is read on the tool hand; which hand was late is read on both arms, while a sensor on one hand reads its own hand's delay and at most part of the other's; and whether a late attempt was also pushed too weakly is not identifiable from passive sensing when the tool hand is late. Within two attempts, a repair policy that escalates when the cause is not identifiable repairs as many failures as one

translated_title: 哪只手迟了？面向双手机器人工具使用中故障恢复的故障诊断
translated_abstract: 面向机器人操作的故障诊断器越来越多地采用视觉-语言模型（VLM），其训练与评估通常基于对成功演示施加扰动所产生的单臂故障。而双手工具使用带来了其他类型的故障：工具在仍被握持的情况下从插口滑出、两个正确的动作在不同时间被执行，以及一次尝试同时因两个原因而失败。在一个模拟的双手机器人工具使用任务中（其故障原因可从记录的轨迹中读出），我们测量了每种感知通道能让诊断器分辨出什么信息。工具的滑出可以从工具手的传感器读出；哪只手迟了可以从双臂的传感器判断，而单手传感器只能读出自己手的延迟以及至多另一只手的部分延迟；当工具手迟了时，这次迟到的尝试是否同时推得力度不足，无法从被动感知中识别出来。在两次尝试内，一种在故障原因不可识别时进行升级（escalate）的修复策略，能够修复与……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文通过双手机器人工具使用任务揭示了不同感知通道可识别的故障类型差异——例如单手传感器无法判断另一只手的延迟或复合故障，并据此提出在故障原因不可识别时进行升级的修复策略，从而在有限尝试次数内实现更有效的故障恢复。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that different sensing channels in bimanual robot tool use can identify different failure causes—e.g., a single-hand sensor cannot detect the other hand's delay or compound failures—and proposes a repair policy that escalates when the cause is unidentifiable, enabling more effective failure recovery within limited attempts.
